name: German Surrender at Stalingrad
summary: WWII: German Sixth Army surrenders at Stalingrad, marking a major turning point on the Eastern Front.

name: Warsaw Ghetto Uprising
summary: WWII / Holocaust: Jewish resistance fighters rise against German deportation efforts in the Warsaw Ghetto.

name: Axis Surrender in Tunisia
summary: WWII: Axis forces surrender in North Africa, opening the way for Allied invasion of Italy.

name: Battle of Kursk
summary: WWII: Germany launches its last major eastern offensive. Soviet defenses absorb the attack, and the Red Army begins the long strategic advance west.

name: Allied Invasion of Sicily
summary: WWII: Allied forces invade Sicily, opening the Italian campaign.

name: Fall of Mussolini
summary: WWII: Mussolini is dismissed and arrested after Italy's military disasters.

name: Armistice of Cassibile
summary: WWII: Italy signs an armistice with the Allies, but Germany occupies much of the country.

name: Allied Landings at Salerno
summary: WWII: Allied forces land on mainland Italy and face fierce German counterattacks.

name: Tehran Conference
summary: WWII: Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin meet to coordinate strategy, including the future invasion of France.

name: Soviet Advance After Kursk
summary: WWII: After Kursk, Soviet forces retake major territory, including Kyiv, and seize the strategic initiative from Germany.
